title: Will the Federal Reserve cut rates at the September 2026 FOMC meeting?
background_info: The Federal Open Market Committee meets eight times per year to set the target range for the federal funds rate.
resolution_criteria: This question resolves YES if the FOMC lowers the target range for the federal funds rate at the meeting concluding 17 September 2026.
fine_print: A change to an administered rate (IOER, ON RRP) without a change to the target range does not resolve this question YES.
